metadata.name: tidebook
metadata.description: Tidebook on-chain central limit order book for Solana

instructions.name: add_admin
docs: Grants an administrator role through an independent PDA record.

accounts.name: super_admin
docs: Governance authority and rent payer for the new role record.

accounts.name: protocol_config
docs: Singleton config proves the signer is the immutable super-admin.

accounts.name: admin_record
docs: Deterministic record whose creation rejects duplicate administrators.

instructions.name: append_limit_order
docs: Appends an order behind the current tail of an existing price level.

accounts.name: trader_balance
docs: Canonical internal ledger that funds and collateralizes this order.

instructions.name: cancel_limit_order
docs: Lets an order owner cancel an open order, including while paused.

accounts.name: previous_order
docs: Older FIFO neighbor. None when canceling the queue head.

accounts.name: next_order
docs: Newer FIFO neighbor. None when canceling the queue tail.

accounts.name: better_level
docs: Higher-priority price level, required only when this level becomes empty.

accounts.name: worse_level
docs: Lower-priority price level, required only when this level becomes empty.

accounts.name: trader_balance
docs: Canonical ledger receiving the released collateral.

instructions.name: close_market
docs: Closes a paused market account and returns its rent to its authority.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Deposits base or quote tokens and credits the caller's free balance.

accounts.name: deposit_mint
docs: Base or quote mint selected for this deposit.

accounts.name: trader_token_account
docs: Trader-owned source token account.

instructions.name: disable_admin
docs: Suspends an administrator without deleting its provenance record.

instructions.name: enable_admin
docs: Restores a previously disabled administrator.

instructions.name: initialize_market
docs: Creates a configured market and its canonical base/quote token vaults.

accounts.name: base_mint
docs: SPL mint for the asset being traded.

accounts.name: quote_mint
docs: SPL mint used to denominate order prices.

accounts.name: vault_authority
docs: and will sign token instructions through `invoke_signed`.

accounts.name: base_vault
docs: Canonical custody account for the market's base asset.

accounts.name: quote_vault
docs: Canonical custody account for the market's quote asset.

instructions.name: initialize_protocol
docs: Creates singleton governance state and the deployer's admin record.

accounts.name: program
docs: Executable whose loader metadata anchors the authorization check.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: Loader state naming the program current upgrade authority.

instructions.name: initialize_trader_balance
docs: Creates the caller's canonical zeroed balance ledger for a market.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Trader owns this balance record and pays its rent.

accounts.name: market
docs: Market whose vaults will eventually back these balances.

accounts.name: trader_balance
docs: Exactly one balance account may exist per `(market, owner)` pair.

instructions.name: insert_limit_order
docs: Inserts an order at a new distinct sorted price level.

accounts.name: trader_balance
docs: Canonical internal ledger that funds and collateralizes this order.

accounts.name: better_level
docs: Adjacent level with higher matching priority, or `None` at the best edge.
Optional accounts cannot carry a static seed constraint for every
insertion shape, so the handler derives and checks their PDAs manually.

accounts.name: worse_level
docs: Adjacent level with lower matching priority, or `None` at the worst edge.

instructions.name: match_limit_order
docs: Settles against one best FIFO maker and removes it when fully filled.

accounts.name: next_order
docs: New FIFO head when the filled maker has another order behind it.

accounts.name: worse_level
docs: Next lower-priority price level when the maker's level becomes empty.

accounts.name: level_rent_recipient
docs: Receives the reclaimed rent when an empty price level is closed.
`maker_price_level.rent_payer`.

instructions.name: pause_market
docs: Stops new order placement while preserving cancellation access.

instructions.name: remove_admin
docs: Closes a disabled administrator record and returns its rent.

instructions.name: unpause_market
docs: Returns a paused market to active trading state.

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Withdraws free base or quote tokens to the caller's token account.

accounts.name: withdrawal_mint
docs: Base or quote mint selected for withdrawal.

accounts.name: owner_token_account
docs: Trader-owned destination token account.

types.name: AdminRecord
docs: Independent role record used to authorize market creation.

types.name: Market
docs: Configuration and lifecycle state for one ordered base/quote market.

fields.name: next_order_id
docs: Monotonic market-local ID assigned to the next submitted order.

fields.name: price_tick_size
docs: Minimum price increment in raw quote-price units.

fields.name: quantity_lot_size
docs: Minimum quantity increment in base-mint atoms.

fields.name: best_bid
docs: Highest-priority open bid price, or `None` when the bid side is empty.

fields.name: best_ask
docs: Highest-priority open ask price, or `None` when the ask side is empty.

fields.name: open_order_count
docs: Number of orders still eligible for matching or cancellation.

types.name: Order
docs: One order submission and its mutable queue and lifecycle state.

fields.name: price_level
docs: Canonical price-level PDA containing this order.

fields.name: previous_order
docs: Older order at the same price.

fields.name: next_order
docs: Newer order at the same price.

fields.name: locked_collateral
docs: Base atoms for asks or quote atoms for bids currently held in custody.

types.name: PriceLevel
docs: One active price in a market-side order-book index.

fields.name: market
docs: Market containing this price level.

fields.name: side
docs: Bid or ask side.

fields.name: price
docs: Tick-aligned price shared by every order in this queue.

fields.name: better_price
docs: Adjacent price with higher matching priority.

fields.name: worse_price
docs: Adjacent price with lower matching priority.

fields.name: first_order
docs: Oldest open order at this price.

fields.name: last_order
docs: Newest open order at this price.

fields.name: total_remaining_quantity
docs: Sum of remaining base quantity across queued orders.

fields.name: order_count
docs: Number of open orders at this price.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Wallet that receives rent when this level is closed.

fields.name: bump
docs: Canonical price-level PDA bump.

types.name: ProtocolConfig
docs: Singleton governance state created by the program upgrade authority.

types.name: TraderBalance
docs: Canonical internal balance ledger for one trader in one market.
Tokens represented here physically remain in the market's SPL token vaults.
`free` balances can be withdrawn or committed to new orders.
`locked` balances collateralize currently open orders.
There is exactly one account for each `(market, owner)` pair.

fields.name: market
docs: Market whose vault assets back these balances.

fields.name: owner
docs: Wallet that owns this balance record.

fields.name: base_free
docs: Base tokens available for withdrawal or new ask orders.

fields.name: base_locked
docs: Base tokens reserved by open ask orders.

fields.name: quote_free
docs: Quote tokens available for withdrawal or new bid orders.

fields.name: quote_locked
docs: Quote tokens reserved by open bid orders.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump stored for future signer and validation logic.

constants.name: ADMIN_SEED
docs: Per-wallet administrator record namespace.

constants.name: MARKET_SEED
docs: Namespace for markets keyed by their ordered base/quote mint pair.

constants.name: MAX_PRICE
docs: Largest representable raw integer price.

constants.name: MAX_QUANTITY
docs: Largest representable raw base-asset quantity.

constants.name: MIN_PRICE
docs: Inclusive raw-price boundary exposed to clients and future validation.

constants.name: ORDER_SEED
docs: Namespace for market-local orders keyed by their monotonic order ID.

constants.name: PRICE_LEVEL_SEED
docs: Namespace for one active market-side-price queue.

constants.name: PROTOCOL_CONFIG_SEED
docs: Singleton protocol-governance configuration.

constants.name: TRADER_BALANCE_SEED
docs: Seed for the canonical balance account belonging to one trader in one market.
PDA:
["trader_balance", market, trader]

constants.name: VAULT_AUTHORITY_SEED
docs: Stateless PDA that owns both token vaults belonging to a market.

constants.name: VAULT_SEED
docs: Token vault namespace; the remaining seeds are the market and asset mint.
